'''Feris''' was a celestial body<ref name="A Past Unthawed" /> located in the [[Feris system/Legends|Feris system]], a part of the [[Agarix sector/Legends|Agarix sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of<ref name="WesternReaches" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It featured polar [[Water/Legends|ice]] caps and was home to a civilization [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]] prior to<ref name="A Past Unthawed" /> [[3637 BBY]]. By approximately that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date SoR">{{TORweb|url=community/showthread.php?p=9852711#edit9852711|text=Charles Boyd on Forums: "Dear Story Team, What Year Are We Currently In?" (1)}} &mdash; According to ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''{{'s}} lead designer, [[Charles Boyd]], the majority of the events of the digital expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan|''Shadow of Revan'']] take place in approximately [[3637 BBY]]. The Crew Skill mission "A Past Unthawed" is part of the ''Shadow of Revan'' expansion and therefore also takes place around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]].</ref> the melting of the ice caps had revealed preserved remnants of the civilization.<ref name="A Past Unthawed" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan}}
Around that [[Time/Legends|time]],<ref name="A Past Unthawed" /> the future [[Alliance Commander|commander]] of the [[Eternal Alliance]]<ref name="Commander">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=3}} establishes that [[Alliance Commander|the Outlander]]&mdash;who becomes the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the future [[Eternal Alliance]] in "Chapter IX: The Alliance"&mdash;also was the player-controlled character in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]''.</ref> sent a companion to investigate the ruins in order to find any valuable relics.<ref name="A Past Unthawed" />
{{Endgame}}

By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]],<ref name="GG10" /> Feris was the site of<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the [[City/Legends|settlement]] known as [[Feris City]].<ref name="GG10" />

==Behind the scenes==
Feris was introduced in [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan|''Shadow of Revan'']],<ref name="A Past Unthawed" /> a [[2014]] expansion for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] developed by [[BioWare]].<ref name="SWTOR dates">{{InsiderCite|207|The Stuff of Legends: A Decade of Star Wars: The Old Republic|The Stuff of Legends: A Decade of ''Star Wars'': The Old Republic}}</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Feris [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the celestial body, in grid square K-17.<ref name="TEA" />
